baseline_models.mechanism: Distributive totality, creaturely knowing, and the paired prayer-glorification terms make universality differentiated: every participant has an appropriate rite, while divine knowledge encloses all of them.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive totality gathers every participant while كُلٌّ distributes the claim one by one.
Disclosure to a knower grounds both each creature's knowing and God's comprehensive knowledge.
Specified worship supplies the image of each creature's own practiced rite.
The parallel mapped inventory reinforces prayer as a binding, regular act rather than an undifferentiated mood.
Worship through praise and prayer links the creature-specific rite to universal glorification.
The closing reference to enacted work keeps the liturgy performative rather than merely attributed.

changed_reading.before: All creation offers a single generic praise.
changed_reading.after: Universal praise consists of distinct, knowingly enacted creature-specific prayers held together under God's knowledge.

baseline_models.mechanism: The swimming-running image within glorification, the bird's aerial lightness, its line formation, and the closing verb of action allow body, trajectory, and formation to function as the medium of praise.

activation_trace.role: Aerial lightness and flight provide the concrete moving body of the model.
Alignment on a level line makes the birds' bodily ordering part of what is perceived.
Swimming, running, and traversing air supply motion as the functional image of glorification.
Enacted work licenses reading the visible flight-pattern as performance, not scenery.

changed_reading.before: The birds praise while incidentally flying in formation.
changed_reading.after: Their flight and alignment can themselves be the embodied performance of praise.

baseline_models.mechanism: The opening demand to see, followed by a visible formation and a knowledge-root that also images a distinguishing mark, makes observable order a clue by which hidden praise is recognized.

activation_trace.role: Eye-sight and insight jointly frame the ayah as an act of recognition.
Rhetorical alert turns the opening question into a demand to reconsider what the visible scene signifies.
A distinguishing sign that guides supplies the secondary image of creaturely order as a legible marker.
The birds' line is the ayah's especially inspectable mark.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports an otherwise hidden cosmic hymn.
changed_reading.after: It also asks the reader to infer that hymn from visible, distinguishing patterns of creaturely order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first separates tongue-carried assertion from knowledge, then makes tongues and limbs testify to deeds. Against that sequence, the focus's coupling of each creature's knowledge, prayer, action, and God's knowledge reads as truthful embodied witness rather than ungrounded utterance.

activation_trace.role: Saying what was not securely known supplies the contrast of assertion detached from truth.
Knowledge is explicitly absent from the tongue-borne claim, exposing the epistemic break.
The tongue as witness relocates truthful disclosure from rumor to embodied testimony.
Intended action is what the body's testimony discloses.
Creaturely and divine knowing close the gap that characterized irresponsible human speech.
Enacted conduct makes the creature's glorification evidence-bearing.

structural_cues: 24:15 places tongue-transmission, speech, and lack of knowledge in one construction.
24:24 makes bodily members testify specifically to what people worked.
24:41 binds knowing, prayer, glorification, and doing before repeating divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech without knowledge, bodily testimony to deeds, and the focus's knowing-doing pair; I infer a contrast in which creaturely praise is truth-bearing embodied evidence. Literal vocal praise remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic praise is imagined chiefly as an anthropomorphic utterance.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic praise is a knowing performance whose ordered action truthfully testifies, unlike speech severed from knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The light discourse and the immediately preceding failure to see one's own hand make the focus's opening question epistemic rather than casually optical; the later call to take a lesson with insight confirms that visible phenomena require right illumination and interpretation.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the condition under which a sign can disclose rather than merely appear.
Failed eye-sight immediately before the focus destabilizes any assumption that seeing is automatic.
The absence of God-given light explains the failure of recognition.
The renewed appeal to sight and insight asks the reader to cross from obscurity into recognition.
Making one condition a lesson for another names the interpretive transfer required by the visible scene.
Insight of the heart confirms that the target faculty exceeds bare eyesight.

structural_cues: 24:35 presents divine light as layered disclosure.
24:40 ends with inability to see and lack of light immediately before أَلَمْ تَرَ in 24:41.
24:44 calls the adjacent natural sequence a lesson for possessors of insight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies light, failed sight, a renewed seeing-question, and an explicit lesson for insight; I infer that recognition of cosmic praise is light-enabled interpretation. Ordinary optical observation remains part of the prompt, especially through the visible birds.

changed_reading.before: Have you not seen is a routine appeal to an obvious natural fact.
changed_reading.after: It is a demand for illuminated discernment: the aligned birds make worship legible, but unilluminated sight can still miss what they show.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, people glorify God in permitted houses, resist distraction, remember God, establish prayer, and are repaid for action; later, named prayers mark daily times. Repetition of the focus's own prayer-glorification pair makes human ritual one specified member of a wider plurality of creaturely rites.

activation_trace.role: Human worship through glorification supplies the nearest concrete instance of the focus's universal predicate.
Refusal to be diverted makes the human rite a sustained orientation rather than a passing utterance.
Maintained recollection supplies the cognitive continuity of the human practice.
Established specified worship gives a concrete human form to prayer.
The second mapped inventory reinforces prayer as an obligatory, structured rite.
Reward for intended action joins liturgy to the focus's closing language of doing.
Named prayers at distinct daily boundaries sharpen the idea that a rite has its own time and mode.
The same worship-praise root extends the nearby human scene to every being in the heavens and earth.
Each creature's possessive prayer preserves specificity inside that extension.

structural_cues: 24:36-37 uses يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ and الصلاة directly before the focus repeats both terms.
24:38 closes the human worship scene with recompense for what they did.
24:58 distinguishes prayers by daily boundary, supporting mode- and time-specific ritual.
24:41 shifts from particular human worshippers to distributive كُلٌّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identical liturgical vocabulary, human discipline, and differentiated prayer times; I infer an analogical continuum in which human worship is one creaturely mode, not that birds and humans perform the same rite. Mere lexical homonymy remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Human ritual and nonhuman praise are separate categories placed near one another.
changed_reading.after: Human remembrance and prayer become one species-specific instance within the ayah's differentiated cosmic liturgy.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the aligned birds, clouds are gently driven, joined, and stacked, while water-born creatures move by sharply different gaits. Those operations activate the swimming-running branch of glorification and make each creature's proper, designed kinematics a plausible form of its own prayer.

activation_trace.role: Swimming, running, and aerial traversal provide the focus anchor for praise as kinematics.
Flight gives the model its first species-specific mode of motion.
Line formation shows that the motion has ordered configuration.
Gentle driving supplies directed motion rather than random displacement.
Joining one thing to another supplies coordinated formation.
Accumulation one part over another gives the cloud a productive ordered structure.
Measured determination links differing bodily forms to designed capacities.
A shared material origin sharpens, by contrast, the diversity of creaturely modes.
Repeated walking and movement distribute action across belly, two-legged, and four-legged gaits.

structural_cues: 24:41 singles out aerial movement in line formation.
24:43 sequences driving, joining, stacking, and issuing rain.
24:45 repeats يَمْشِي across three bodily configurations while retaining a common watery origin.
The focus's كُلٌّ and possessive صلاته preserve distinct modes within universality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered motions, designed forms, and the motion branch of س ب ح; I infer that faithful enactment of a creature's proper movement can count as its glorification. The adjacent natural processes may instead be examples of power without defining praise.

changed_reading.before: All creatures praise in essentially the same unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: Each creature can praise by enacting the distinct motion, formation, and capacity measured into its form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate declaration of divine sovereignty and return, together with the surah's closing knowledge, return, disclosure, and deeds, turns the focus's final omniscience clause into jurisdiction and accounting. Cosmic glorification thereby acknowledges an order of ownership to which action returns.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty over the same heavens and earth gives the focus's universal scene a jurisdictional frame.
Movement toward the final outcome makes creaturely action return rather than dissipate.
Comprehensive knowledge at the surah's close repeats the focus's enclosure of all action.
A delivered report turns known deeds into disclosed account.
Intended work is the content of that final disclosure.
Universal worship becomes the enacted acknowledgment situated inside sovereignty.
The focus's deeds-language is the exact hinge from liturgy toward accountability.

structural_cues: 24:42 immediately restates the heavens and earth as divine sovereignty and names the return.
24:64 closes the surah by joining divine knowledge, return, reporting, and what people did.
24:41 itself moves from universal glorification to God's knowledge of action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty, return, reporting, and deeds around the focus's knowledge clause; I infer a forensic dimension in which praise acknowledges jurisdiction and action is accountable. The closing clause can still function as a non-forensic statement of omniscience.

changed_reading.before: God knows what they do merely reassures that every hidden praise is observed.
changed_reading.after: The clause also places every performance within divine sovereignty, return, disclosure, and accountability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats spatial relation as liturgical rather than scenic. It remains anchored in صَافَّاتٍ and gains mechanism from the adjacent contrast between opaque layering and productive joining-stacking; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial analogy, not as a lexical definition of tasbih.

activation_trace.role: Alignment on a level line makes inter-body relation explicit in the focus.
Repeated vertical superposition produces an opaque, disorienting arrangement and shows that geometry can bear consequence.
Joining parts supplies a constructive relational operation.
Productive stacking supplies an ordered geometry from which rain emerges.

changed_reading.before: The bird formation is a decorative detail accompanying praise.
changed_reading.after: The line itself may participate in praise: right relation and arrangement among bodies can function liturgically.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the racing image of the one who follows the leader within both mapped prayer inventories. It remains anchored in صَلَاتَهُ, the birds' line, and the surah's competing tracks of following and obedience; downstream prose must qualify it as a secondary word-image, never replace the ordinary sense of prayer with it.

activation_trace.role: The runner who follows the leader supplies prayer as ordered succession behind a precedent.
The parallel mapped branch preserves the same following image across the split inventory.
The birds' line gives ordered following a visible focus anchor.
Following and trailing supply the surah's negative counter-course.
Tracks and steps followed by a traveler make course-selection concrete.
Compliance supplies the positive alternative of entering the right course.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is only address or ritual directed upward.
changed_reading.after: Prayer may also carry a secondary image of entering the proper sequence behind a divinely set lead, a course creatures know while humans can follow wrongly.

strongest_changes: The light-darkness sequence turns أَلَمْ تَرَ into illuminated discernment rather than casual eyesight.
Human glorification and prayer in 24:36-38 become one specified instance of differentiated cosmic liturgy.
Cloud formation and diverse animal gaits strengthen praise as ordered creaturely action.
Speech without knowledge and bodily testimony recast praise as knowing, truth-bearing performance.
The sovereignty and closing-account frame gives God's knowledge of deeds an accountable dimension.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context activated a coherent link among visibility, knowledge, embodied order, and accountable action while preserving distinct liturgical, kinematic, epistemic, and forensic readings.
remaining_uncertainties: How literally creaturely knowledge in عَلِمَ should be rendered remains open.
Whether tasbih is audible, behavioral, or both is unresolved.
The geometry and following models depend on non-primary branch images and must remain explicitly exploratory.
